title: Mega Droid - A Web Old School Action-RPG Platformer
author: CreativeProblem7803
selftext:
**Playable Link**: [https://playgama.com/game/mega-droid](https://playgama.com/game/mega-droid)

**Platform**: Desktop Web browser and or Playgama Mobile App

**Description**: Mega Droid is an Old School Action-RPG Platformer in First-Person View and toon look. Rogue machines have overrun the city's sectors, and only Flux can take them back. Beam into each sector, explore rooms and corridors, and blast Hardhats, drones and brutes with your charge cannon. Hold to charge, release at the perfect moment for a critical hit, raise your shield to block, and parry right as the ring closes. Open supply chests for new gear, level up, wire your skill circuits, and defeat each Core Master to copy its special weapon.

**Free to Play Status:** Free to play

**Involvement**: Solo developer of this old school game.

**AI Disclore:** I used Claude Code Opus 5.5 heavily to build this game. It created the levels, the toon look and enemy designs. I directed the game art style and game design vision over 4+ weeks. Sounds and Voice-over are from Elevenlabs.
